changelog: **Registry reports sliced by org attributes (#1920, part 3):** `GET /api/admin/reports/[key]?segmentBy=<attribute>` (groupBy: one block of rows per segment, a leading `segment` column in JSON/CSV/XLSX) and `&segment=<value>` (filter). Implemented once in the registry (`loadReport`) for every report that declares a `segmentSubject` — pipeline funnel and summary, cohort comparison, source conversion, mentor workload, placement outcomes, weekly-report compliance — as a relation subquery on the subject person, never an id list. The privacy floor runs **after** the split (`src/lib/reports/segmentRule.ts`, unit-tested): segments under `minCohort` fold into one named below-threshold bucket (with people who have no value, when that group is small), a single small segment answers `suppressed`, and the segments partition the population so totals reconcile. A DATE attribute slices by derived tenure. Query count: 3 to plan + the loader's own per shown segment (≤ 12 + other/no value/bucket). A deleted or non-segmentable attribute degrades to the unsliced report (`segmentIgnored`), never a 500; report subscriptions can store a slice (`segmentBy`/`segment`) and the job honours it. New `/admin/reports` screen to read, slice and download the registry reports.

en: Reports can be sliced by your own attributes — department, location, tenure and more — on the new Reports screen and in scheduled reports. Groups under five people are always combined, and the totals still add up.
tr: Raporlar artık kendi özniteliklerinize — bölüm, konum, kıdem ve daha fazlası — göre yeni Raporlar ekranında ve zamanlanmış raporlarda kırılabilir. Beş kişiden küçük gruplar her zaman birleştirilir ve toplamlar tutar.
de: Berichte lassen sich jetzt nach Ihren eigenen Attributen — Abteilung, Standort, Betriebszugehörigkeit und mehr — aufschlüsseln, im neuen Bildschirm „Berichte“ und in geplanten Berichten. Gruppen unter fünf Personen werden immer zusammengefasst, und die Summen stimmen.
